text:
```yaml
name: Claude on Mention

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Run Claude on @claude mention
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: '@claude'
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          prompt: |
            You are a helpful assistant. Respond to the comment with relevant information or guidance.
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
